claims.text: The FDA diazepam label describes increased sedation with alcohol.
claims.quote: Alcohol Concomitant use with alcohol is not recommended due to enhancement of the sedative effect.

claims.text: The Spanish label says alcohol with Valium can potentiate sedation and respiratory depression.
claims.quote: Se puede producir también una potenciación de los efectos adversos sobre la sedación y depresión respiratoria cuando se administra Valium de forma concomitante con depresores del SNC, incluyendo alcohol.
claims.quoteEnglish: Adverse effects on sedation and respiratory depression may also be potentiated when Valium is administered with CNS depressants, including alcohol.

headline.text: The FDA diazepam label describes increased sedation with alcohol.

reported.text: The Spanish label also describes potentiation of respiratory depression when Valium is combined with alcohol.
